title: Thursday Daily Practice
subtitle: Listening: four map-labelling tasks under exam conditions
source: Daily Practice tuần 2 (print/I3/Daily_Practice_Week2_source.md), bài I3 Leisure and Recreation
intro: Work through 3 steps, about 25 minutes. You need the Theatre audio (sent by the teacher on Zalo at 7:00). Listen to the recording once, as in a real exam. Deadline 00:00 tonight. Complete and on time earns 20 Meow; late or half done earns 10 Meow. Do not look at the answers before you finish.

farm.label: Audio · Fiddy Farm (Cambridge 11, Test 1, Section 2, Q15–20)

rec.label: Audio · Recreation ground (Cambridge 16, Test 4, Part 2, Q15–20)

newb.label: Audio · Newbridge (Improve your IELTS, page 45, Track 1.28)

steps.title: Step 1 · Theatre
steps.instructions: Start in the foyer. Pay attention to the water cooler and the double doors (image: images/map_theatre.png). Listen once and choose letters A to G.

items.explain: Bằng chứng: next door, with a separate entrance from the road. Bẫy: box office không nằm ở chỗ công chúng nghĩ.
Bằng chứng: rẽ phải, end of the corridor, door on the left.
Bằng chứng: rẽ trái, rẽ phải ở water cooler, rẽ phải lần nữa, phòng thứ hai.
Bằng chứng: rẽ phải, the first room on the right-hand side.

steps.title: Step 2 · Trap tracker
steps.instructions: Write one sentence for each trap you fell into. If you did not fall into any trap, write one sentence about a place the speaker mentions that is not the answer, using the pattern: ... is wrong because ...

open.q: Câu về bẫy hoặc địa điểm bị loại
open.model: The Heights is wrong because the speaker says it is further from the High Street than The Towers.

steps.title: Step 3 · Reflection voice note
steps.instructions: Record a voice note of about 1 minute in English: which direction words helped you most today, and why.
lines: Which direction words helped you most today? Why?
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét cách dùng từ chỉ hướng và cách giải thích của em.

send_today: Hoàn thành 6 bước trên web, chụp ảnh các map đã điền gửi lên Zalo. Voice note ở Step 6 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
